rationale: Sean is building spatial computing and AR systems that reject voice-only interaction in favor of direct manipulation interfaces on smart glasses — work that requires strong fullstack and web capabilities. Steve is a polyglot engineer (typescript, javascript, python, rust, c++) with active open source contributions and interest in emerging technologies, making him well-positioned to contribute to or learn from Sean's work on VisionClaw and Reality Proxy.
intro_message: Sean, meet Steve — he's a software engineer intern at Workday with multi-language depth (typescript, javascript, rust, c++) and open source experience that could complement your spatial computing and AR work at Fusion Reality.
